description: A drafted cooling-off 通知 / refund demand / complaint artifact (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_compose). kurashimori ASSISTS the member in drafting; the member reviews + owns + (default) sends it. CONSTITUTIONAL: drafting-assistance, NOT 作成代理 reserved to 司法書士/弁護士 (G5; only representable assistMode is 'drafting-assist'); the draft must use lawful, non-threatening language (G10); the member always confirms before send (G8); the draft content lives ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds the POINTER + metadata, never inline content.

memberDid.description: The member who owns the draft (complainant, G3/G4)

sessionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the parent complaintSession

encryptedDraftRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the draft (G6); never inline content

assistMode.description: Always drafting-assist — never 作成代理 (G5). Schema-level invariant: no other value representable.

memberConfirmed.description: G8 — the member has reviewed + confirmed the draft before it may be sent
